input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: The warranty package is otherwise good: § 19.1 gives professional/workmanlike performance plus material conformity to documentation and specifications, § 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and compliance with Applicable Law, § 19.4 supplies the full repair/re-perform/replace-then-refund remedy, and § 19.5 expressly prevents the disclaimer from swallowing the express warranties. The single material failure is duration. § 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to fifteen days after delivery and then states Vendor "has no correction or refund obligation," which cuts off the untimed § 19.1 conformity warranty and the § 19.4 remedy. Fifteen days is below the fallback of 30 days for services (Deliverables are defined in § 1.4 as custom work product, so the services benchmark applies) and it is effectively consumed by the fifteen-business-day acceptance test in § 6.1, leaving no warranty coverage for defects appearing in productive use. Redline extends the period to ninety (90) days, the preferred position for services deliverables, and confines the cut-off to this Section so it does not override § 19.3, the service levels or the indemnities. Thirty days remains available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformity warranty from 15 to 90 days and confine the cut-off to this Section
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformity warranty from fifteen to ninety days, which is our standard period for services deliverables, and confirmed the cut-off applies only to this warranty rather than to Section 19.3, the service levels or the indemnities. A fifteen-day window essentially expires with the acceptance-testing period in Section 6.1 and leaves us no remedy for defects that surface in normal use; we can discuss thirty days as a fallback if the longer period is difficult.

ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation under this Section 19.2, without limiting any other warranty, service level, indemnity, or remedy in this Agreement.
